zh: 你意外获得了一笔钱！怎么使用是个问题。
en: You unexpectedly received a sum of money! How to use it is the question.

zh: 之前的投资有了丰厚的回报！
en: Your previous investment has yielded generous returns!

zh: 人到中年，各种压力接踵而来，你感到前所未有的迷茫。
en: In middle age, various pressures come one after another, and you feel unprecedentedly lost.

zh: 你决定重新振作，走出低谷！
en: You decide to pull yourself together and rise from the low point!

zh: 经历了大半辈子，你突然对人生有了新的领悟。
en: After most of your life, you suddenly have a new understanding of life.
Stand your ground, never back down
Politely decline, carry the burden alone

zh: 无力承担，只能保守治疗
en: Can't afford it, opt for conservative treatment
Watch day and night, care attentively

zh: 尽力而为，但也要顾自己
en: Do your best, but also take care of yourself

zh: 暂时搁置，等情况好转再说
en: Put it on hold for now
Feel proud of your family member

zh: 让家人开始工作补贴家用
en: Have them start working to help the family

zh: 开心出行，花点钱也值得
en: Happy outing, spending a bit is worth it
Channel grief into strength, face it bravely

zh: 捐出大部分，留一小部分
en: Donate most, keep a small portion
Double the effort, try again next year
Cut losses, give up the startup
Decline the gift, only seek guidance
Save it for a rainy day
Start fresh, change the status quo
Comprehend the true meaning of life
